[[Icirrus Gym]] }} '''A Cold Reception''' (Japanese: '''VS ツンベアー''' ''VS Beartic''), titled '''VS Beartic''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 505th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 45th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Beartic''' (Japanese: '''条件''' ''Conditions'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''A Cold Reception''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Costa]] evolves into {{p|Carracosta}}. * {{adv|Black}} defeats [[Brycen]] and earns the {{badge|Freeze}}. * Black obtains the [[Light Stone]]. * Black attempts to summon {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}}, but fails. * Black learns that the League's date has been pushed up and becomes worried that he won't be able to compete in the League without eight Badges. * Brycen tells Black about the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}. * [[Iris]] suggests that he try to awaken Reshiram, but Black claims that it's impossible and runs off. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Carracosta}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * {{adv|N}} (fantasy) * [[Brycen]] * [[Drayden]] * [[Iris]] * [[Alder]] (fantasy) * [[Ghetsis]] (fantasy) * {{tc|Doctor}} Logan * [[Kimi]] * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s (fantasy) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munna}} ([[Musha]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Tirtouga}} ([[Costa]]; {{adv|Black}}'s; evolves) * {{p|Carracosta}} ([[Costa]]; {{adv|Black}}'s; newly evolved) * {{p|Beartic}} ([[Brycen]]'s) * {{p|Druddigon}} ([[Drayden]]'s) * {{p|Zekrom}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Reshiram}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Keldeo}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Cobalion}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Terrakion}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Virizion}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}; fantasy) ==Trivia== * In the original Japanese magazine version, the last few pages of this chapter were originally published as a part of [[PS508]]. Since the pages caused a continuity error by leading into the events of PS508 and leaving no room for encounter with the [[Swords of Justice]], the pages were moved when collected into {{PAV|49}}. **This part of the last few pages of this chapter in the European French version is named "Le choix de Watson" (Drayden's Choice).
